system.description: Base Essence (Elemental Companion) 5.9.2 - Flame's Course. Controlling fire itself rather than throwing it: lighting, sheltering, hiding, suppressing, extinguishing, or making fuel burn more efficiently, concealing smoke, a corridor cleared through flames, heat/infravision, creating growing rings and columns of fire, causing a doused fire to flare back up (Back Draft, House Fire), and ultimately reversing fire's damage back into healing. Fidelity note: level 20 (Suppress Fire II)'s description is truncated in the source ("As Suppress Fire I, except area of effect" with no number given) - completed here as "50' radius" since that's exactly what the table's own Area of Effect column lists for this row.

Instantly lights a fire if sufficient fuel is available. Fire is limited to no more than 1' radius per level. Fire is as hard to put out as a fire that has been burning for an hour (i.e. a breeze or light rain will not put it out).
This spell protects fires in the radius from wind and rain, requiring 3 times the amount from either source to put out fire.
Eliminates all smoke within the radius for the duration. Spell must be centered on an immobile point.
All natural fires within the 10' radius of this spell are extinguished.
Fires in the radius burn fuel more efficiently; fuel lasts five times as long. This spell must be centered on an immobile point.
As Shelter Flame, except the radius is 10'.
Causes target fire (of at least 2' R) to explode in a 10' R blast. All those in the area suffer an attack on the Fire Ball Table.

All fires in the radius are invisible, in addition, no smoke nor light can be seen. Fire will still give off heat, those that can see heat spectrums will still see it. Fire source will visibly char and be consumed and will still ignite combustibles.
Caster is able to see the difference in temperatures while concentrating and gains infravision.

Caster creates a 3' high column of fire. The column then starts moving outward to become a circle of fire with a 6 inch thickness. Flames move at a rate of 1 foot per round. All combustibles in contact with the flames are ignited. Any being who comes in contact with the flames suffers an 'A' Heat critical.
Caster causes a 3' wide corridor through a fire, clearing all flames, heat and smoke from the area. Anyone may walk through the corridor without being affected by the heat from the surrounding fire.
As Conceal Smoke, except it affects up to a 15' radius.

Fires in the area (up to 20' radius) are suppressed, causing the flames to vanish. Fire will not spread nor consume any additional material for the duration. Items that were on fire are still hot to the touch and have a 50% chance of delivering an 'A' heat critical for every round of contact. Fire will return when the duration expires or the spell is canceled.

Causes target fire (up to 5' radius, but at least 1' radius) or less to stop burning for one round. The following round the fire explodes outward up to 3 times its original radius. Attack is resolved as a +25 Fireball.
As Create Fire I, except for area of effect and duration.
As Flare Up I, except radius of explosion is 20'.
As Shelter Flame, except radius is 30'.
Target's heat emanations blend with the environment; target cannot be seen by creatures with heat vision.
Wood and other combustibles in an enclosed building or structure, smolder for a round then burst into flame; flames are intense and deliver an attack on the Fireball Attack Table each round.
As Suppress Fire I, except area of effect is 50' radius.

Caster causes a ball a fire to shoot from his palm. The ball then travels to a point designated by the caster, where it explodes with concussive force. Resolve attack on the Fireball Attack Table, delivering double damage and additional Impact criticals of equal severity. Fires in the area of effect are starved of oxygen and blown out.

Caster causes all damage/effects from natural fire in the radius (up to 5') to be reversed. All spells from this list qualify for being natural fire for the purposes of this spell. Wounds will be healed and wood repaired. However if someone dies, his soul will not be returned to him.
As Create Fire I, except for the radius and duration. Additionally the fire travels at 5' per round.
